pins.replay: lot_replay.mjs read and confirmed to extract the OEM-GATE and AM-GATE blocks and helper functions from docs/app.js verbatim into a vm; I ran a copy that differs only in taking app.js as an argument and also recording each donor's warn text (2 lines changed, diff kept in the method notes). Payload apps built with junkyard_scraper._oem_gated_apps for all 214 shippable groups.

draw.method: shippable = candidate likely minus GROUP_HOLD_CATS, sorted by id; cats sorted; largest remainder; rng.sample per cat in cat order; then rng.sample(rest sorted,30); per pair rng.choice seeker vy then rng.choice donor vy != seeker (vys sorted)

method_notes: Draw: shippable = candidate 'likely' (217) minus GROUP_HOLD_CATS (read from scraper/junkyard_scraper.py: wiper-motor's 3 groups held) = 214, sorted by id; categories sorted; largest remainder over 30 -> climate-control 2, gauge-cluster 4, side-mirrors 8, window-regulator 16; random.Random(27641119).sample per category in that order; then rng.sample(remaining 184 sorted, 30) for pairs; per pair rng.choice(sorted vehicle-years) as seeker, rng.choice(the others) as donor. audit11_4/sample.py not used.

Pages: my own reader (scratch raw.py) over git objects of oem-raw@57e8b5b9 (git show of the six jsonl files, sha256 checked against the candidate's raw block). Own-page evidence per vehicle-year = rows of that catalog's list pages (lists.jsonl) plus the list_info of product records whose list_url is that vehicle-year's page (records.jsonl). The crawler's own fields (matched, excluded_by, flags) were not used.

App: lot_replay.mjs read; it extracts canonicalMake/pfSquash/pfSquashModel/pfAppMatches/splitCategoryMake/expandV2Row/pfAmParseEngine/pfAmCarTrans, the AM-GATE and the OEM-GATE blocks verbatim from docs/app.js into a node vm and calls pfOemDonorGate per donor; its candidate prefilter is the same squash test pfAppMatches does. I ran a scratch copy differing in two lines (app.js path taken from argv; each donor's warn text recorded). Payload apps from junkyard_scraper._oem_gated_apps for all 214 groups. Lot: 338616 cars; totals plain 38357 / if-equipped 5424 / excluded 297 (car x group).

'Plain row' = verdict confirm with no gate line; every OEM Likely row still carries its group note (option / some configurations / verify the number). Trim and package limits inside an 'option' or 'fits some configurations' note were accepted as covered; drive, engine, fuel, cab, transmission and build-window limits were not (the app has gates for those).

Cab abbreviations T / KC / CC are not defined anywhere in the raw pages; they were read as regular / king / crew cab because pickup pages use exactly these body codes (Frontier T/KC/CC, Titan KC/CC). Claims whose cab wording depends on that reading are noted, not counted RISK.
Not checked: the hybrid catalog pages of QX60/Q70 (not in oem-raw: the years page offers them, only 'gas' was read); any page outside oem-raw@57e8b5b9; donor build dates (no source).
window_rule: Window rule used throughout (an assumption, not on the pages): model year Y is taken as built 08/(Y-1)..07/Y. An ungated vehicle-year whose own page gives the deciding row a Production Date window that cuts inside that span is RISK; a window ending or starting just outside it is noted, not counted.

census.note: My own census (scratch mycensus.py) over all 214 shippable groups, same page reading. Lot counts are car x group rows (a car can count in two groups).

cab_gate_without_cab_on_page (the WRONG.lot: 454 car x group rows, 227 distinct Titan donors (2005 145, 2010 32, 2011 30, 2012 20), all if-equipped with the line "this part is listed for crew cab only"; none plain, none excluded.

qx60_2.5L_decodes_plain_under_gas_only.detail: window-regulator FR:361942cc55 9, FL:0a6d4c77d8 9, RR:e01e9e3108 8, RL:7a9947516c 8, RR:f315a587d8 9, RL:9c3158fe6c 9; side-mirrors R:ccf0dd8c02 1, L:27714784b8 1

suggestions: Cab gates: give cab the same basis field drive already has (stated / inferred). The six Titan rear-door groups infer crew-cab-only (probably right physically) but the line says 'listed for crew cab only'; an inferred cab should say so, as drive_basis 'sibling' does.
QX60 2014-2017 gas-only groups: add eng_not ['2.5L'] (as round3 did elsewhere) or read the hybrid catalog pages the years page already offers; 54 2.5L QX60 donors are plain under a 'gas only' note.

Build windows: the curation gates some years and not others for the same window (82721-0E715 gated on Altima 1994, not 1996 where the window ends 02/1996). A census like the one here (window vs. the model year's build span) would catch the 7 groups listed.

The '*' mark: 33 groups rest only on starred clauses. Its meaning is not on the pages; one targeted look at what the site means by it (a legend page, if the operator approves fetching it) would settle 91 vehicle-years either way.

Drive/transmission words inside option clauses (Xterra 'W. 4WD. S. 6MT') are left to the option note; a 4WD-automatic Xterra donor is plain. Consider an 'if equipped' drive/trans line where a page restricts a drive to one transmission.

Pages disagree on one number's production window (96302-7S600: 10/2004-08/2006 on 2007 Titan, 10/2004-08/2005 on 2006 Armada, none on 2004/2005 pages); when windows disagree the claim could say so or stay if-equipped on every year.
